_comment: An edit adds a static import of a module that is already in the graph but was never executed or shipped (it is reachable only through a never-called import()). The patch must also carry heavy.js, or the re-run of hmr.js hits initModule('heavy.js') with no factory. The browser counterpart (lazy compilation, multi-tab) is the `hmr-new-static-dep-unloaded-chunk` playground in packages/test-dev-server.
